store.summary: Proxmark3 RFID/NFC toolkit with native 320x170 GUI
store.description: Native arm64 build of the RfidResearchGroup/proxmark3 client paired with a custom 320x170 Linux framebuffer + keyboard GUI designed for the M5Stack CardputerZero APPLaunch environment. Supports Auto Scan, HF/NFC, LF/RFID, Hardware tuning, Saved Dumps viewer, USB serial, Proxmark5 BWM BLE, RDV4 BlueShark Classic Bluetooth (with automatic Wi-Fi coexistence handling), Offline mode, and full interactive CLI console.
